title: Split controlplane.svelte.js into modular stores
observed_behavior_before: web/src/lib/stores/controlplane.svelte.js contained connection state, bootstrap orchestration, event routing, collection state arrays, and dedupe maps in one 880-line module.

The controlplane-store unit test failed before this split because stale module instances retained nostr.connected subscribers across vi.resetModules(), causing duplicate subscriptions and stale EOSE handling.
intended_behavior: Existing imports from web/src/lib/stores/controlplane.svelte.js remain compatible through a slim re-export layer.
Connection, bootstrap, event routing, and collection concerns live in focused modules under web/src/lib/stores/controlplane/ and web/src/lib/stores/collections/.
Each collection module owns its $state arrays and dedupe Maps while event routing delegates application to those modules.

Bootstrap remains Nostr-native: it subscribes to scoped REQ filters, applies EVENTs immediately, marks historical catch-up complete only after EOSE from connected relays, and ignores stale EOSE from replaced subscriptions.
